svg.text: The vertical plate hangs from the left leg,
flat on the left wall (see next view).
ELEVATION A (looking at the left wall: plate in true shape)
منظر أ (نحو الحائط الأيسر: اللوح بحجمه الحقيقي)
2 holes dia 5, 20 below the top edge, at 40 and 130 from the corner
ELEVATION B (looking at the right wall: plate edge-on)
منظر ب (نحو الحائط الأيمن: اللوح من جانبه)
right-leg flange (dashed): 15 fold, 2 holes, hidden fixing
الزعنفة على الضلع الأيمن: تثبيت مخفي
REFERENCE PHOTO (Sabry, 12 Nov; maker unknown, device on the shelf is not ours)
Rev 1 (Sabry, 15 Nov): a wedge, one triangle
top, and a vertical triangular plate hanging
from its left leg, flat on the left wall.
The shelf-top device in the photo is not drawn.
مراجعة ١: وتد من مثلث واحد مثني ٩٠°
Colourways: bare brushed stainless (proposal). No paint colour. ألوان: ستانلس مبشور بدون دهان (مقترح).
Leg 250 x 250 is Sabry's (15 Nov, "make it 25 x 25"; was 22 x 22). Thickness 2, plate depth 250, flange 15, screws, pair: PROPOSALS,
not costed, Production to confirm. Overall height 252 = top plate 2 + plate 250 below it. المقاسات عدا ٢٥٠ مقترحة، يؤكدها التصنيع.
